  • Conhecimento em Sienge, AutoCAD, Revit, ferramentas de gestão de projetos ou sistemas de protocolo municipal
  • Vivência com estudos de massa, viabilidade urbanística e análise de terrenos
  • Experiência em relacionamento com órgãos públicos e gestão de exigências técnicas

Buscamos uma pessoa com perfil técnico, organizado e com forte capacidade de articulação.

O perfil ideal combina:

title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. O que Buscamos?

Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications

Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
  • Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
  • Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
  • Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);
  • Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);

Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente;

Contratação CLT

O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;

  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;

Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Onboarding & Operations Lead
description:
About the role

We are looking for a data-driven, process-oriented, and customer-centric Onboarding & Operations Lead to own the end-to-end activation for our highest-value partners in Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the entire lifecycle of Strategic Key Accounts (SKA) from contract signing to tech launch, ensuring high-quality activation even under tight resource constraints.
  • Design, document, and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), governance frameworks, and operational workflows to reduce downstream rework and support business scalability.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Payments, and Compliance teams to define requirements and support the development of online tools, APIs, and system integrations that automate manual onboarding.
  • Establish clear Standards of Approval (SLAs) with Sales and Business Development (BD) teams to ensure complete merchant data quality right from day one.
  • Personally orchestrate onboarding architecture for hyper-complex cases (massive multi-store structures, complex payment/clearing logic).
  • Leverage data analytics, dashboards, and core metrics (TAT, conversion rates, and activation accuracy) to proactively trace process bottlenecks and execute actionable improvements.
  • When necessary, manage external operations or partners responsible for verification activities, establishing strict performance metrics and quality controls.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Key Account Operations, Technical Onboarding, or Project Management within high-growth internet ecosystems (O2O, Delivery, E-commerce, Fintech, or Global SaaS).
  • xperience structuring operations or scaling customer journeys in highly dynamic, fast-paced international environments.
  • Strong analytical ability to translate complex business languages and messy offline workflows into scalable product and technical requirements.
  • : Exceptional stakeholder management skills—adept at driving horizontal alignment across Engineering, Sales, Support, and Product squads.
  • Solid understanding of operational excellence frameworks (certifications like Scrum, Agile, Gestão de Projetos, or Lean Six Sigma are highly valued).
  • Full professional proficiency in English and Portuguese

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (PwD). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

title: Key Account Sales Director
description:
JD Industrials | Director of Key Account Sales, Brazil

Work Location : Brazil (based in São Paulo, regular nationwide business travel)

Reporting to : Latin America Regional Lead

1. Business Overview

  • JD Industrials is the B2B industrial supply chain division of JD Group. We deliver one-stop digital procurement solutions covering MRO spare parts, industrial consumables, electrical automation, tools & security equipment, production materials and other industrial goods, and implement an accompanying global expansion strategy.
  • As Latin America’s largest industrial market, Brazil hosts numerous Chinese enterprises expanding overseas in new energy vehicles, construction machinery, infrastructure engineering, mining and manufacturing, alongside major local industrial conglomerates. JD Industrials has established a local legal entity in Brazil. Leveraging cross-border supply chains, local warehousing & distribution, customs clearance fulfillment and digital procurement platform capabilities, we serve Chinese-owned factories operating in Brazil and leading local industrial clients.
  • As the lead for key account sales in Brazil, this role takes charge of local KA client acquisition, commercial negotiations and long-term account management, builds the key account sales system, and drives sustained revenue growth of industrial goods business in Brazil.

2. Job Responsibilities

  • Key Account Development & Target Delivery

Take overall ownership of acquiring Chinese overseas enterprises and large local KA clients across manufacturing, infrastructure, energy and mining sectors in Brazil. Formulate key account sales strategies and annual business plans, deliver revenue, gross profit and collection targets assigned by headquarters, and secure long-term framework bulk procurement agreements. Independently engage client procurement directors, supply chain leaders and factory management teams; oversee the full lifecycle of business opportunities, tendering, commercial negotiations and contract signing.

  • In-depth Account Management & Demand Mining

Identify procurement pain points at client factories. Combine JD Industrials’ supply chain strengths to deliver customized solutions including MRO consolidated procurement, hybrid cross-border & local fulfillment, and digital procurement services. Continuously increase wallet share among existing clients, tap incremental opportunities across multiple production sites and subsidiaries, and foster long-term strategic partnerships.

  • Local Market & Competition Analysis

Continuously research Brazil’s industrial goods market regulations, major competitors, pricing frameworks of local suppliers, industry policies and import customs requirements. Produce periodic market analysis reports, feed client demands and category opportunities back to the regional headquarters, and support optimization of localized product assortments and fulfillment solutions for Brazil.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Project Execution

Coordinate with local Brazil teams covering operations, supply chain, customs and finance, as well as procurement & sales teams at China headquarters. Manage end-to-end order fulfillment, delivery tracking, invoicing & payment collection, and after-sales issue resolution. Control client receivables risks to maintain healthy cash flow.

Sales Team Building & Management (0-to-1 Local Team Establishment)

Build a local Brazilian key account sales talent pipeline aligned with business progress. Set individual KPIs and performance appraisal mechanisms. Equip the team with capabilities for business development and solution-based industrial sales, and coordinate joint efforts to deliver priority projects.

  • Ecosystem Partner Development

Engage local industry associations, channel partners and logistics service providers appropriately to expand lead sources and cultivate a sound local business ecosystem.

3. Job Requirements

  • Education & Language

Bachelor’s degree or above; fluent Portuguese (mandatory for commercial negotiations); English as working auxiliary language. Proficiency in Chinese is preferred (significant advantage for engaging Chinese enterprises).

Industry Experience (Mandatory)

Minimum 8 years of B2B industrial goods key account sales or sales management experience, with deep expertise in MRO, industrial spare parts, electrical equipment, tools, security products, automation and engineering materials. Familiar with industrial bulk procurement models and factory procurement decision-making chains.

Hands-on experience operating in the Brazilian market and existing client resources in manufacturing, new energy, infrastructure and mining sectors are preferred. Prior experience serving Chinese enterprises expanding overseas is a plus.

  • Core Competencies

Proven track record of 0-to-1 overseas market development. Expertise in annual bulk procurement negotiations and framework agreement management for large conglomerates. Basic understanding of cross-border industrial trade, import customs clearance and localized fulfillment. Result-oriented mindset with strong awareness of receivables risk control.

Capable of independently managing client projects with annual transaction volumes ranging from millions to tens of millions. Adept at solution-based sales instead of pure product trading.

  • Work Location Adaptability

Long-term assignment in Brazil; able to undertake frequent inter-city business travel within Brazil. Familiar with Brazilian business culture, labor laws and trade regulations. Comfortable with cross-time-zone collaboration with China headquarters.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working experience with Schneider Electric, 3M, Grainger, RS Components, MISUMI, major local industrial distributors or cross-border industrial supply chain companies;
  • Understanding of industrial e-commerce and digital procurement platform business models;
  • Established senior-level connections with Chinese-owned factories or local industrial conglomerates in Brazil.

title: COORDENADOR COMERCIAL & DE QUALIDADE
description:
COORDENADOR(A) COMERCIAL E DE QUALIDADE

A True Coffees é uma exportadora de cafés verdes do Brasil e importadora no mercado americano. confiança, previsibilidade e visão de longo prazo. Acreditamos em um futuro mais humano e próspero para a cadeia do café, onde qualidade, relacionamento e valorização da origem caminham

juntos.

SOBRE A OPORTUNIDADE

A True Coffees busca um(a) Coordenador(a) Comercial e de Qualidade para atuar na nova unidade de São Francisco de Paula, MG. A posição integra relacionamento com produtores, originação e comercialização de cafés e avaliação técnica de qualidade, sendo uma referência local da True Coffees junto aos produtores da região. Procuramos um profissional pleno, com conhecimento profundo do mercado de café e capacidade de transitar com segurança entre campo, mesa de prova e negociação. A função exige autonomia, leitura de mercado, visão de longo prazo e uma abordagem genuinamente orientada à construção de relações sólidas com produtores.

FOCO DA FUNÇÃO

Relacionamento com produtores | originação e comercialização | classificação e degustação | formação de preço.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

• Desenvolver e fortalecer relacionamentos de longo prazo com produtores de café da região, atuando como referência comercial e técnica da True Coffees na unidade.

• Prospectar novos produtores e ampliar a base de relacionamento da empresa, identificando oportunidades de originação alinhadas às demandas e à estratégia comercial da True Coffees.

• Conduzir negociações de café com produtores, avaliando oportunidades, condições comerciais, qualidade, volume e momento de mercado.

• Realizar classificação física e degustação de cafés comerciais, apoiando decisões de compra, valorização, separação e direcionamento dos lotes.

• Formar e analisar preços por diferencial versus os mercados futuros de NY/B3, considerando qualidade, condições de mercado e contexto comercial de cada negociação.

• Acompanhar os mercados futuros, o mercado físico regional e os movimentos de preço, transformando essas informações em suporte para decisões comerciais e oportunidades de originação.

• Dar devolutivas técnicas e comerciais aos produtores sobre qualidade, posicionamento de mercado e oportunidades, fortalecendo relações de confiança e visão de longo prazo.

• Coordenar as rotinas comerciais e de qualidade da unidade, mantendo organizados os fluxos de amostras, análises, lotes, negociações, registros e informações relevantes.

• Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de qualidade, logística, financeiro e operações para assegurar a correta execução dos contratos e o fluxo do café após a negociação.

• Representar a True Coffees em visitas a produtores, mesas de prova, reuniões e demais interações comerciais relevantes na região.

• Compartilhar com a liderança informações de mercado, percepções da origem e oportunidades comerciais que possam contribuir para a estratégia da empresa.

O QUE BUSCAMOS

• Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência no mercado de café, com atuação consistente em comercialização, classificação e degustação de cafés comerciais.

• Sólido domínio de classificação física e avaliação sensorial de cafés comerciais.

• Entendimento prático e consistente sobre formação de preço por diferencial versus mercado futuro, especialmente NY/B3.

• Experiência comprovada em negociação e desenvolvimento de relacionamento comercial com produtores de café.

• Modelo mental orientado à construção de relações de longo prazo com produtores, com presença, confiança, consistência e capacidade de gerar valor para ambas as partes.

• Boa capacidade de negociação, análise comercial e tomada de decisão.

• Autonomia, organização, responsabilidade e capacidade de coordenar rotinas e prioridades da unidade.

• Facilidade para integrar análise de qualidade e decisão comercial em uma mesma negociação.

• Disponibilidade para deslocamentos frequentes na região para visitas e relacionamento com produtores.

DIFERENCIAIS

• Habilidade e experiência na degustação e avaliação sensorial de cafés especiais.

• Conhecimento profundo da região de São Francisco de Paula e relacionamento prévio com produtores locais.

title: Mainframe Solution Architect - Remote
description:
About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Role Purpose

Provide end-to-end technical leadership for enterprise solutions on the mainframe platform: translating business and non-functional requirements into scalable, secure and resilient architectures, and guiding engineering teams through implementation, modernization and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Design
  • Own high-level and detailed architecture for complex mainframe applications, APIs, integrations and modernization initiatives.
  • Convert functional and non-functional requirements into blueprints, component designs, interface contracts and implementation guidance.
  • Select appropriate architecture patterns and assess trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, cost and maintainability.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise standards, approved platforms, reusable patterns and target-state roadmaps.
  • Technical Leadership & Governance
  • Give hands-on architectural direction to development, QA, DevOps, security and support teams.
  • Set coding, API, integration, logging, configuration, testing and deployment standards.
  • Run architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, technical risk assessments and PoC evaluations. Security, Reliability & Performance
  • Embed secure-by-design across identity, authorization, secrets, data protection and interface security.
  • Define resiliency patterns — retry, timeout, failover, HA and DR — plus performance and capacity targets.
  • Ensure observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards and alerting.

Technology Focus — Mainframe

  • Design, develop and support COBOL/CICS/DB2 batch and online components within agreed standards.
  • Optimize batch windows, DB2 access paths and resource consumption to protect service levels.
  • Support mainframe modernization, API exposure and integration with distributed and cloud platforms.

Required Technical Competencies

  • COBOL, JCL, CICS, VSAM, DB2 and z/OS utilities; batch and online program design and optimization.
  • Mainframe application architecture, modularization, API enablement and modernization/coexistence patterns.
  • Data & Integration DB2 and VSAM data design, SQL tuning, file handling, data conversion, integrity and reconciliation.
  • Platform & DevOps z/OS operations, scheduling, change management, environment promotion and mainframe-to-distributed integration.
  • Quality & Operations Unit and regression testing, batch cycle validation, performance and MIPS optimization, defect RCA.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story. Since 1997, we’ve put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future. We’re a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut. Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people. Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to come.

We're looking for a Senior Accountant to join our team in São Paulo, taking ownership of finance, accounting, tax, legal, IT and treasury — from financial statements and management reporting to budgeting and cash management. You'll work closely with our Trade, Logistics, Operations and Control teams in Brazil, and partner with the Finance Manager to help build systems, processes, and tax, legal and treasury structures from the ground up.

We're looking for someone who is a collaborative team player as well as an independent thinker, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a hands-on, proactive approach to improving processes. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and bring innovative thinking that adds value across the organization.

Interested? Let's connect!

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate accounting records per local statutory requirements and group policies, and perform month-end/year-end closing, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and schedules.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and resolve discrepancies promptly, and support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting packages.
  • Manage AR in collaboration with corporate and local teams, and handle payments and customer invoicing, including entering payment instructions and coordinating approvals for timely, accurate release.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls and accounting procedures, and support external and internal audits with documentation and explanations.
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations and filing requirements, and prepare, review, and coordinate direct and indirect tax filings and payments on time.
  • Maintain accurate records for tax-related transactions and balances, and prepare tax reconciliations, provisions, and deferred tax calculations.
  • Coordinate with external tax advisors and support corporate income tax compliance, including transfer pricing, intercompany transactions, and related tax reporting.
  • Coordinate tax audits, inspections, and inquiries from authorities, and support electronic invoicing and digital tax compliance requirements.
  • Monitor tax legislation changes and assess business impact, while continuously improving tax processes, controls, and reporting efficiency.
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, HR, and external providers on financial and tax reporting, and support SAP-related finance and tax projects, testing, and improvements.
  • Contribute to automation, standardization, and continuous improvement across finance.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master’s Degree in Finance / Accountancy / Tax
  • 3+ years’ experience in finance and accounting department
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS and SAP.
  • Good working knowledge of direct and indirect taxation.
  • Experience in risk management including credit, market and foreign currency risk.
  • Experience with implementing IT systems.
  • Proficient with MS Office .
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Experience of working in an international environment; experience working in a commodity trading company is preferred

We Offer

  • An entrepreneurial and international environment where developing opportunities for growth is valued
  • Training opportunities, locally and globally
  • Health insurance
  • Meal support (vale refeição)
  • Transport support/Parking lot (Vale transporte ou vaga de estacionamento)

Please submit your resume/CV in English.

Please note that we may incorporate an assessment and reference checks in our selection procedures.

Estamos com vagas abertas para profissionais de edição de vídeo que queiram atuar na produção de conteúdos audiovisuais institucionais, educativos e digitais, da roteirização à entrega final.

Buscamos pessoas criativas, organizadas e ágeis, com boa comunicação escrita e capacidade de transformar conteúdos em vídeos claros, dinâmicos e atrativos. As responsabilidades e a autonomia serão compatíveis com o nível de experiência.

A apresentação de portfólio com vídeos finalizados é indispensável , preferencialmente com animações ou motion graphics. Para o nível trainee, serão aceitos projetos acadêmicos ou autorais.

Atividades da vaga

  • Elaborar e adaptar roteiros para vídeos institucionais, educativos e para redes sociais;
  • Criar storyboards e planejar a narrativa visual dos vídeos;
  • Editar e finalizar vídeos, trabalhando cortes, ritmo, trilha sonora, legendas e correção de cor;
  • Acompanhar gravações em estúdio, apoiar a direção e realizar atividades de operação de câmera e captação de áudio, conforme o nível de experiência;
  • Produzir animações 2D e motion graphics, como vinhetas, lettering e infográficos animados;
  • Tratar e mixar áudio, integrando locução, trilhas e efeitos sonoros;
  • Adaptar vídeos para diferentes formatos e plataformas, como YouTube, Instagram e ambientes de educação a distância;
  • Aplicar a identidade visual e os padrões gráficos de cada projeto;
  • Revisar os materiais e realizar ajustes a partir dos feedbacks da equipe;
  • Organizar e versionar arquivos, projetos e bancos de mídia.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Audiovisual, Cinema, Comunicação Social, Publicidade e Propaganda, Design, Animação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em edição de vídeo e produção audiovisual compatível com o nível pretendido — para trainee, serão consideradas experiências acadêmicas e projetos autorais;
  • Portfólio com vídeos finalizados;
  • Conhecimento de Adobe Premiere e After Effects compatível com o nível da vaga, sendo aceitos conhecimentos básicos para trainee;
  • Conhecimento de Adobe Audition e Illustrator;
  • Noções de design gráfico, composição e tipografia aplicados ao vídeo;
  • Noções de operação de câmera, iluminação e captação de áudio em estúdio;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Criatividade, proatividade e boa comunicação escrita;
  • Agilidade na execução, com atenção à qualidade e capacidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos e prazos;
  • Organização, abertura a feedbacks e disposição para aprender e aprimorar os materiais.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com materiais educativos, institucionais ou cursos online;
  • Conhecimento de animação 3D em Blender, Cinema 4D ou ferramentas similares;
  • Conhecimento de Photoshop, Figma ou DaVinci Resolve;
  • Noções de acessibilidade audiovisual, incluindo legendagem acessível e integração de audiodescrição e janela de Libras;
  • Experiência com transmissões ao vivo ou gravação de aulas;
  • Experiência na produção de materiais para órgãos públicos, projetos sociais ou educação corporativa.

Condições de contratação

  • Regime: CLT;
  • Local de trabalho: Asa Norte, Brasília/DF — presencial;
  • Níveis: trainee, júnior, pleno e sênior;
  • Remuneração: definida conforme o nível e a experiência do(a) candidato(a);
  • Benefícios: vale-transporte, vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição, vale-cultura e plano de saúde opcional;
  • Jornada: de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h.

Ao se candidatar, informe o nível pretendido e inclua o link do seu portfólio.

title: Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho (217)

FORMAÇÃO:

CONHEÇA NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:

INVESTIMOS NO SEU DESENVOLVIMENTO PROFISSIONAL:

Valorizamos pessoas que têm atitude, motivação e vontade de crescer.

Somos líderes em aromas e ingredientes para o mercado de alimentos e bebidas da América Latina. Fundados em 1º de dezembro de 1925, em Jaraguá do Sul (SC), possuímos operação em 8 países: no Brasil, com unidades em Santa Catarina, São Paulo e Sergipe; no México, Chile e na Colômbia; além de contar com um Centro Avançado de Inovação e Logística na Alemanha e escritórios na Polônia, China e Estados Unidos. O futuro tem a nossa essência. 100 anos é só o começo.

title: Pessoa organizada e atenta
description:
About us

Jumpstart Immigration provides a safer, more reliable path for global founders and skilled professionals seeking U.S. residency or work visas. We simplify the world’s most complex immigration processes by merging high-level legal expertise with statistical models and artificial intelligence. This data-driven approach allows us to offer an industry-leading 100% approval-or-refund guarantee for O-1 visas, including insurance coverage for government filing fees, thereby minimizing financial risk for our clients. Our methodology significantly accelerates the process, with application timelines often compressed into just one to two weeks.

Through our exclusive Founders Package, we provide a holistic transition to the U.S., encompassing immigration strategy, company formation partnerships, tax planning, and relocation services. Beyond the O-1, we are a strategic partner for high-talent categories, including EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, E-2, L-1, and H-1B.

Website:

Role Description

You will be the primary point of contact for our clients, guiding them from day one (Onboarding) until they secure their visa or Green Card. We are looking for more than just a customer service representative; we need a strategist who knows how to organize evidence, manage expectations, and ensure every petition is delivered with excellence and strictly on time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Onboarding Management: Lead the initial kickoff, welcoming clients and defining the next steps of their journey.
  • Case Strategy: Analyze client profiles to design the best strategy for visa/immigration benefit applications.
  • Evidence Management: Guide and follow up with clients regarding document submission, organizing all necessary inputs for the final petition assembly.
  • Legal/Ops Liaison: Ensure a seamless process flow, translating client needs into technical documentation and coordinating with the legal team.
  • Continuous Engagement: Conduct frequent video meetings for status updates and data collection.

Qualifications

  • Professional Experience: Proven experience as a Case Manager, Operations (Ops) Analyst, Customer Success, or in roles requiring complex process management.
  • Process-Oriented: Experience managing the "middle ground" between sales and final delivery, ensuring no operational stage is overlooked.
  • Advanced/Fluent English: Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively with international clients and institutions (Essential).
  • Desirable: Prior knowledge of immigration or legal fields (this is a plus, but not mandatory if you have a solid background in Operations).

The ideal profile

  • Ironclad Organization: You will handle a high volume of simultaneous clients. The ability to prioritize and a strong sense of urgency are non-negotiable.
  • Communication & Soft Skills: Ability to manage diverse client profiles worldwide, maintaining composure and professionalism under pressure.
  • Proactivity: A "hands-on" profile who doesn't wait for things to happen but makes them happen.

Location & Compensation

This is a fully remote position, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere. However, we believe in the power of face-to-face collaboration; therefore, the role involves occasional in-person meetups for strategic planning and team building.

General Info

Compensation: R$ 7.000,00 (PJ)

Workload: Full-time

Start date: Immediately

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
VOCÊ QUER SER ASSESSOR OU QUER CONSTRUIR UM NEGÓCIO?

Existe uma diferença.

Na Verini, acreditamos que o assessor não deve apenas atender clientes.

Ele deve construir uma carteira, desenvolver relacionamentos e participar do valor que ajudou a criar.

E é justamente aqui que entra um dos pontos mais importantes do nosso modelo:

EQUITY.

Não basta dizer que você pode se tornar sócio.

É preciso existir uma estrutura clara de precificação da participação e, principalmente, um mecanismo que dê segurança para que aquilo que você construiu tenha valor e possa ser recebido mesmo diante de situações inesperadas.

Para nós, esse é um dos pilares mais importantes de uma sociedade de verdade.

Porque construir patrimônio durante anos e não ter clareza sobre quanto vale a sua participação ou sobre como ela será realizada no futuro não é construir com segurança.

É por isso que acreditamos que nosso modelo de sociedade está entre os formatos mais completos para quem quer construir uma carreira de longo prazo.

Aqui, você encontra:

→ Liberdade para construir

→ Meritocracia para crescer

→ Transparência nas relações

→ Participação no valor que ajuda a criar

→ Mecanismos de segurança para o seu patrimônio

→ Visão de longo prazo

Mas isso não é para todo mundo.

Estamos procurando pessoas com foco, intensidade, resiliência e espírito empreendedor.

Pessoas que entendam que ser assessor não é simplesmente ter uma profissão.

É construir um negócio.

Seu suor merece construir algo que também seja seu.

Oportunidade em Lajeado/RS

ANCORD necessária para atuação

Verini Investimentos

  • Liberdade para construir. Segurança para crescer.

title: Pesquisador Doutor - Markal - Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em soluções de pulverização - Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL PR
description:

O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Você deseja atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções voltadas à pulverização agrícola e contribuir para a evolução de produtos e componentes com alto impacto no campo? title: 经理
description:
1. Take full responsibility for the plant quality team and Quality Management System. Develop annual quality objectives, operating plans, departmental budgets, and quality improvement programs, and remain accountable for overall plant quality performance.

2. Establish and continuously improve quality control processes for commercial vehicle assembly, including incoming inspection, station inspection, in-process inspection, quality gates, end-of-line testing, road testing, PDI, and final vehicle release.

3. Establish critical quality control points throughout the vehicle manufacturing process, with particular focus on the chassis, axles, powertrain, cab, electrical harnesses, braking system, steering system, lighting, sealing, critical torque, and overall vehicle functionality.

4. Establish vehicle release and stop-release mechanisms. Promptly quarantine, rework, stop shipment, and escalate any vehicle that fails to meet applicable quality, safety, or regulatory requirements.

5. Lead the resolution of major on-site quality issues. Organize containment actions, defect reproduction, 8D analysis, 5 Whys, and root-cause validation, and implement permanent corrective actions with lessons learned deployed across similar products and processes.

6. Establish a rapid-response mechanism for batch quality issues. Organize quality walls, 100% inspections, sorting, rework, and screening of potentially affected vehicles to prevent defective vehicles and components from reaching the market.

7. Lead quality planning for new models and new projects, including risk identification during the APQP phase, DFMEA and PFMEA reviews, Control Plan development, inspection standard development, and quality gate planning.

8. Manage quality follow-up during prototype builds, trial builds, pilot production, and production ramp-up. Drive closure of open issues, confirm process capability, and approve quality readiness for serial production.

9. Participate in product and process change management to ensure alignment among the Bill of Materials, drawings, process documents, software versions, inspection standards, and actual production configuration, preventing incorrect assembly, missing parts, and mixed product versions.

10. Establish control and traceability mechanisms for special characteristics, critical dimensions, critical torque values, and regulatory components, ensuring that all relevant quality data is accurate, complete, and readily traceable.

11. Manage the calibration and control of gauges, measuring instruments, inspection equipment, and testing equipment. Organize Measurement System Analysis, Statistical Process Control, and process capability studies.

12. Collaborate with the Supplier Quality team to resolve incoming material defects and supplier-related batch quality issues. Drive suppliers to implement containment actions, complete 8D corrective actions, and achieve sustained improvement.

13. Establish a closed-loop process for after-sales quality issues. Regularly analyze failures reported by dealers, service centers, fleet customers, and end users, and drive improvements in product design, manufacturing processes, assembly, and inspection.

14. Analyze warranty claims, early-life failures, repeat repairs, and major customer complaints to reduce market PPM, failures per 1,000 vehicles, warranty claim rates, and warranty cost per vehicle.

15. Promptly organize risk assessments for issues involving vehicle safety, regulatory compliance, or potential batch exposure. Support field containment, recall assessments, vehicle rectification campaigns, and communication with regulatory authorities.

16. Establish and maintain the IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. Organize internal audits, process audits, product audits, management reviews, third-party certification audits, and customer audits.

17. Ensure that audit nonconformities, customer complaints, and internal quality issues are analyzed, corrected, verified, and formally closed within the required timelines, preventing recurrence of similar issues.

18. Collaborate with Product Compliance, Homologation, Certification, and Engineering teams to ensure that vehicle conformity of production, product configuration, and quality release comply with applicable Brazilian vehicle approval, environmental, and safety requirements.

19. Establish a plant quality KPI management system, conduct regular quality review meetings, and issue daily, weekly, monthly, and special quality improvement reports.

20. Manage quality-related costs, including rework, scrap, customer claims, and warranty expenses. Identify major sources of quality loss and lead cost-reduction initiatives.

21. Take responsibility for the organizational planning of the quality team, including recruitment, staffing, role definition, skills matrices, training and certification, performance coaching, and succession planning.

22. Establish departmental and individual KPIs, cascade annual objectives, conduct regular performance reviews, and ensure that the team achieves the quality targets required by the company.

23. Collaborate with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, R&D, Purchasing, Supplier Quality, After-Sales Service, Product Compliance, Homologation, and Sales teams to ensure the timely resolution of quality issues.

24. Establish an emergency-response mechanism for major quality risks. In the event of batch failures, major customer complaints, or safety-related quality incidents, organize an immediate response and promptly report the situation to senior management.

title: Remote Litigation Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M&A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration.
  • Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies.
  • Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses.
  • Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief.
  • Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions).
  • Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up.
  • Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Analista de Logística Júnior
description:
Nosso desafio

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Logística Júnior para atuar na Usina Vertente em Guaraci.

O que buscamos em um profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Quais serão as responsabilidades?

  • Analisar relatórios diários do setor;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias (financeira e/ou operacional), para a Logística;
  • Auxiliar na performance dos diversos setores que se reportam à área de Logística;
  • Apoiar nas cotações e contratações de transportadores e autônomos;
  • Contribuir como integrador entre as áreas comercial e industrial, analisando as demandas de mercado e a capacidade de produção;
  • Apoiar no controle das atividades de armazenagem e carregamento de produtos acabados;
  • Acompanhar a movimentação diária de carregamento para o mercado interno e exportação de açúcar e álcool;
  • Apoiar na administração da entrega de produtos acabados para os clientes, bem como transferência de produtos acabados para os centros de distribuição e entre unidades, de acordo com a programação disponibilizada pelos representantes comerciais ou programação elaborada pelo gerente da área;
  • Prestar atendimento aos representantes comerciais, transportadoras, operadores portuários e clientes, disponibilizando informações e relatórios sobre as operações;

Quais são os requisitos?

  • Ensino superior em Logística, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência com análise de dados, pacote office e Power BI;

Local de trabalho

Guaraci/SP

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 10.700 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana- de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 8 países, 36 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.600 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2024/25, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de €5,9 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas seis unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
Position Details

Job Title: Regional Sales Executive — Northeast Brazil

Business: Acceleronix | Quectel

Region: Northeast Brazil (Recife/PE or Fortaleza/CE), with eventual expansion into the North

Location: Recife, PE or Fortaleza, CE

Work Arrangement: Remote, with recurring in-person presence at clients and prospects across the region, plus occasional meetings at the Campinas office

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Up to 40% within the region, plus occasional travel to Campinas

Reports To: Head of Sales, LATAM

Function: Sales / New Business Development

About the Role

Acceleronix is establishing its first dedicated commercial presence in Northeast Brazil, a growing market with no existing Acceleronix coverage today. This is a hunter role: you will prospect and close new medium and large accounts across fleet management, asset tracking, payments, smart metering, and related IoT verticals, acting as the local face of Acceleronix while building a pipeline of your own rather than relying on inbound leads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect and close deals with medium and large companies in the Northeast (with eventual expansion into the North), focused on fleet management and asset tracking, and also including Payment and Smart Metering, among other related IoT verticals.
  • Act as the local commercial point of contact, with recurring in-person presence at clients and prospects across the region.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline, from qualification through close, in coordination with the Head of Sales LATAM and the Inside Sales/SDR team.
  • Track and monitor local competitors, including MVNOs and IoT connectivity providers operating in the region.
  • Present technical-commercial proposals, including products such as SIM DUO, vSIM, and eSIM, together with the Solutions team.
  • Negotiate contracts, commercial terms, and SLAs with corporate clients.
  • Report pipeline metrics, forecast, and results in a structured way.

What We Expect

Primary Focus — Grow and Bring In New Accounts

  • Prospect and close new accounts quickly, with a strong sense of urgency and focus on results — this is the primary success metric for the role.
  • Directly contribute to revenue growth in the region — a growing market with no dedicated Acceleronix commercial presence today.
  • Establish Acceleronix’s active presence in the Northeast through participation in events, trade shows, and visits that reinforce the brand locally.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of new business, without relying solely on leads handed over by the SDR team.

Secondary — Farm the Accounts Won

  • As business volume grows, take on managing and growing the accounts you have brought in, keeping clients satisfied through visits and close support.
  • Anticipate churn risk on accounts under your management and act proactively to retain them.

Requirements

Required

  • Based in Recife/PE or Fortaleza/CE.
  • Strongly hunter-profile — proven track record of generating and closing new business, not just portfolio management.
  • Proven track record in consultative B2B sales, preferably in telecom, connectivity, IoT/M2M, or technology.
  • Availability to travel up to 40% of the time within the region, plus occasional meetings at the Campinas office.
  • Self-discipline and organization to work in a remote setup, with strong written and verbal communication.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at an MVNO, carrier, or IoT/M2M connectivity provider.
  • Familiarity with industry concepts: SIM DUO, vSIM, eSIM, national roaming, ICCID/IMSI/IMEI, LTE-M, NB-IoT.
  • Existing relationships with clients or partners in the Northeast.
  • Intermediate/advanced English, for interaction with the Quectel group.

About Acceleronix

Acceleronix is Quectel’s integrated IoT platform and connectivity company, built to help businesses launch and scale connected products faster. The company provides consulting, PCBA design, global SIM connectivity, and a secure device management platform, bringing hardware, connectivity, and software together into a single, end-to-end offering rather than requiring customers to stitch together separate vendors.

Operating as part of the Quectel ecosystem, Acceleronix is positioned as a trusted end-to-end IoT partner delivering scalable, reliable solutions from design through deployment, and appears alongside Quectel at major industry events such as MWC and the World IT Show to showcase joint IoT deployments across smart agriculture, smart home, and connected-device use cases.

Why Acceleronix / Quectel?

  • Build Something From Zero — Establish Acceleronix’s first dedicated commercial presence in the Northeast, with the autonomy and visibility that comes with owning a new territory.
  • End-to-End IoT, Not Just Modules — Sell a company that combines hardware, connectivity, and platform software into one offering, rather than a single point in the IoT stack.
  • Real Customer Deployments — Represent solutions already running in production across fleet management, asset tracking, and smart metering.
  • Career Growth — Clear path to farming and growing the accounts you bring in, plus international exposure within a fast-scaling global organization.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market
  • Sales commission / performance bonus tied to new business and account growth
  • Meal and grocery vouchers
  • Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents
  • Dental coverage
  • Life insurance and accident cover
  • Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at , or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on LinkedIn.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.

Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Analista Tributário PL
description:
Analista Tributário PL

Sobre a Empresa

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Sobre a Função

Executar as atividades de apuração de tributos indiretos, obrigações acessórias e controles fiscais, garantindo a conformidade com a legislação vigente. Apoiar processos, projetos, auditorias e parametrizações tributárias, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional e redução de riscos fiscais.

  • Efetuar a conciliação de contas fiscais e contábeis relacionadas a ICMS, ICMS DIFAL, IPI e CIAP, garantindo a consistência das informações.
  • Acompanhar alterações na legislação tributária e apoiar na avaliação dos impactos fiscais, operacionais e sistêmicos.
  • Apoiar na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria dos processos tributários e de mitigação de riscos fiscais.

  • Participar de projetos fiscais relacionados a novos negócios, implantação de processos e atendimento de demandas regulatórias.
  • Executar a manutenção de parametrizações fiscais no SAP, incluindo J1BTAX e demais tabelas dos módulos MM e SD, sob orientação da coordenação.
  • Prestar suporte às áreas internas em questões tributárias relacionadas às operações da companhia.
  • Atuar no atendimento a auditorias internas e externas, disponibilizando documentos, análises e esclarecimentos necessários.

Requisitos

title: Ombudsman / Ouvidor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.

Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is looking for a qualified Ombudsman (Ouvidor) to manage the mandatory Ouvidoria structure for our regulated VASP entity under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025, Resolution BCB No. 28/2021, and CMN Resolution No. 4,860/2020.

Serving as the second-instance escalation mechanism, the Ombudsman acts independently from operational and sales teams, championing client rights and reporting systemic insights directly to top management.

Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Second-Instance Complaints: Receive, register, and resolve complex client complaints escalated from standard customer service (SAC) within mandatory BCB resolution timeframes.
  • Independent Mediation: Act as an impartial mediator between clients and internal operational units.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Identify recurring operational failures or systemic compliance risks and recommend corrective action plans to executive leadership.
  • BCB & Board Reporting: Prepare periodic Ombudsman reports ( Relatório de Ouvidoria ) detailing complaint volume, resolution metrics, and root cause analyses for internal governance and BCB regulatory filings.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven background in Client Advocacy, Ombudsman (Ouvidoria), Legal, or Regulatory Compliance within BCB-regulated financial institutions, payments, or crypto platforms.
  • Consumer Law: Solid working knowledge of the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (Código de Defesa do Consumidor - CDC) and BCB Ouvidoria regulations.
  • Certifications: Active Ombudsman Certification (Certificação de Ouvidoria by Anbima, Febraban, or Abecip), required.
  • Languages: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory) and professional working English (preferred).

Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory Compliance & Dispute Resolution: Deep understanding of BCB consumer protection frameworks, Resolution BCB 28/2021, CMN 4,860/2020, and the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code ( CDC ).
  • Executive Presence: Ability to act as an autonomous authority, presenting independent semi-annual Ombudsman reports ( Relatórios de Ouvidoria ) to the Board of Directors and BCB examiners.
  • Strong Analytical & Root-Cause Analysis Skills: Capability to analyze complaint data, identify recurring product/operational bottlenecks, and drive structural recommendations.
  • High Accountability & Ownership: Strong commitment to meeting strict regulatory response deadlines (BCB SLA requirements) and managing regulatory exposure.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mediation: Proven ability to liaise neutrally between aggrieved customers, internal business lines, Legal, Compliance, and Operations teams.
  • Ability to build scalable dispute resolution infrastructure: Capacity to design and scale second-instance ticketing systems, automated SLA tracking, and complaint reporting workflows tailored for fast-growing financial platforms.

Nice to Have

  • Fintech & Cross-Border Experience: Background handling complex customer grievances related to international wire transfers, eFX exchange rates, Pix transactions, or digital asset settlements.
  • BACEN Reporting Exposure: Prior experience inputting data into or submitting regulatory complaint reports through official BCB reporting portals (Unifoco/RDR).
  • Legal/Regulatory Background: Formal education or background in Legal, Consumer Law, or Compliance within regulated financial institutions (IPs/SDFs/VASPs) in Brasil.

Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Gerente de Apoio Comercial
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e o Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados mundiais nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com uma das maiores carteiras de seguros do mercado, temos sede na Espanha e comercializamos nossos produtos por meio do canal de vendas do Banco Santander no Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.

Na Zurich Santander, trabalhamos todos os dias para que você seja o protagonista de nossa história e tenha o espaço que merece dentro da nossa empresa. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, este é o seu lugar!

Nosso objetivo é oferecer a você as melhores experiências, queremos que se junte a nós para que juntos possamos construir o futuro da Zurich Santander!

Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades?

  • Capacitar Gerentes da Rede Comercial;
  • Apoiar no pós venda de Seguros;
  • Fomentar as vendas com a criação de campanhas;
  • Apresentar painéis de gestão dos indicadores;
  • Ser referência no tema de seguros para todos os steakholders do banco.

Quais são os requisitos que procuramos?

  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência com seguros ou produtos relacionados;
  • Certificação CPA-20 ou CEA (C-Pro R ou C-Pro I);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Para que possa fazer a diferença, é ideal que você tenha as seguintes softskills para esta função:

  • Comunicação;
  • Relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Orientação para resultados;
  • Liderança.

Qual é a nossa Proposta de Valor ?

Na Zurich Santander lhe propomos fazer parte de uma organização comprometida com o contexto atual, trabalhando profissionalmente na transformação da indústria bancária/seguradora, oferecendo-lhe crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.

Contamos com um excelente ambiente de trabalho, uma equipa de profissionais diversificada e internacional, incentivamos a mobilidade dentro dos países onde estamos presentes para que possa continuar a crescer como profissional. Além disso, dispomos de um pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo e atrativo para os nossos colaboradores.

Junte-se à nossa equipe!

#Juntosprotegemosoquemaisimporta

title: Gerente de Projetos - PMO
description:
Seu próximo desafio está aqui!

Na Webmotors, não buscamos apenas talentos — buscamos pessoas que queiram acelerar junto com a gente , impulsionadas pela escolha de ir além e pavimentar o caminho do sucesso.

Somos a principal plataforma digital do segmento automotivo no Brasil, transformando a experiência de compra e venda de veículos por meio da tecnologia, inovação e de um time apaixonado por causar impacto real .

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de acelerar ideias, desviar de obstáculos com leveza e manter o olhar lá na frente , sempre buscando ser um pouco melhor a cada dia. Valorizamos e impulsionamos cada talento, oferecendo um ambiente seguro e inclusivo, onde o crescimento profissional e pessoal são prioridades.

Somos CAR Group. Somos Santander. Somos Webmotors! E estamos prontos para pilotar essa transformação com você.

Vem com a gente fazer parte de algo grandioso!

#SejaParteImportanteDeAlgoGrandioso #BeABigPartOfSomethingBig

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Webmotors está abrindo uma posição de Gerente de PMO Estratégico dentro do time de Estratégia.

Será responsável por conduzir projetos que atravessam várias áreas da companhia e por fazer times que não reportam a você entregarem no prazo. O impacto vem da qualidade da sua condução, não do tamanho do seu time.

Você vai atuar no centro da execução estratégica da Webmotors: os projetos que passam por essa cadeira são os que a liderança acompanha de perto.

Responsabilidade e Atribuições:

  • Conduzir projetos estratégicos de ponta a ponta Estruturar o escopo, desenhar o plano de trabalho, definir marcos e entregáveis, e levar o projeto do kickoff ao encerramento — incluindo projetos multi-área, com stakeholders de Produto, Tecnologia, Comercial, Marketing e Financeiro.
  • Governança e cadência Estabelecer e rodar os rituais de acompanhamento: status reports, reuniões de steering, fóruns de decisão. Garantir que as decisões sejam tomadas no fórum certo, registradas e cumpridas.
  • Gestão de riscos, dependências e bloqueios Antecipar o que pode travar a entrega, mapear dependências entre times e escalar no momento certo — nem cedo demais, nem quando já virou crise.
  • Visibilidade e reporte Construir a visão consolidada do portfólio: o que está no prazo, o que está atrasado, por quê e o que precisa ser decidido. Produzir materiais claros e objetivos para a liderança e para o comitê executivo.
  • Padrões e método Evoluir a forma como a companhia gerencia projetos: templates, critérios de priorização, definição de done, métricas de acompanhamento. Sem burocratizar — o objetivo é acelerar a entrega, não criar processo.
  • Encerramento e aprendizado Fechar projetos formalmente, medir resultado contra o que foi prometido e transformar o que deu errado em melhoria do próximo ciclo.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência em gestão de projetos, PMO, planejamento estratégico ou consultoria;
  • Experiência em conduzir projetos multi-área com stakeholders sênior;
  • Domínio de metodologias de gestão de projetos (waterfall, ágil e híbrido) e clareza sobre quando usar cada uma;
  • Estruturação de problemas: transformar um pedido vago em plano de trabalho com escopo, prazo e responsável;
  • Ferramentas de gestão de portfólio e trabalho (Monday, Jira, Asana ou equivalentes);
  • Excel/Google Sheets em nível avançado e PowerPoint com qualidade executiva;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Experiência em ambientes de ritmo acelerado — tech, plataformas digitais ou marketplaces será um diferencial.

Informações adicionais:

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido , com três dias presenciais por semana na sede do Santander, na Vila Olímpia . Um espaço colaborativo, moderno e cheio de conexões — onde ideias ganham velocidade e pessoas impulsionam o futuro.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
About the Role

岗位简介

1、We are looking for a proactive and service-oriented E-commerce Merchant Operations Specialist to join our team in São Paulo.

我们正在寻找一位积极主动、具备服务意识的 电商商家运营专员 加入我们在圣保罗的团队。

2、This role will focus on onboarding new merchants, conducting product training and system configuration, as well as following up on and resolving issues merchants encounter while using our products.

该岗位将专注于新商家的接入工作，进行产品功能培训与系统配置，并在商家使用我们产品的过程中，跟进并解决遇到的问题。

3、The ideal candidate will be fluent in both Portuguese and Chinese , with strong communication skills and a high sense of service.

理想的候选人需要精通 葡语和中文 ，具备出色的沟通能力和高度的服务意识。

Key Responsibilities

主要职责

  • Lead the onboarding process for new e-commerce merchants, including account setup, system configuration, and product feature activation.
  • 负责新电商商家的接入工作，包括账户设置、系统配置及产品功能启用。
  • Conduct product training sessions for new merchants to ensure a smooth and efficient adoption of our platform and tools.
  • 为新商家提供产品功能培训，确保他们能够顺畅、高效地使用我们的平台与工具。
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for merchants regarding product usage, troubleshooting, and ongoing operational support.
  • 作为商家在产品使用、问题排查及日常运营支持方面的主要对接人。
  • Follow up on, diagnose, and resolve merchant issues promptly, escalating complex cases to relevant internal teams when necessary.
  • 及时跟进、诊断并解决商家遇到的问题，必要时将复杂情况升级至相关内部团队处理。
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement in the merchant onboarding and support process, and contribute to knowledge base and documentation updates.
  • 主动识别商家接入与支持流程中的改进机会，协助完善知识库与相关文档。
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of our products, features, and e-commerce industry trends to better serve merchants.
  • 持续学习并掌握公司产品、功能及电商行业动态，以更好地服务商家。

Qualifications & Requirements

任职资格与要求

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Business, E-commerce, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 本科及以上学历，商业、电子商务、信息技术或相关专业。
  • Proficiency in both Portuguese and Chinese is essential.
  • 葡语和中文 流利是必要条件。
  • Prior experience in merchant operations, customer support, account management, or a related role within the e-commerce or SaaS industry is a strong advantage.
  • 有电商或SaaS行业商家运营、客户支持、客户管理或相关岗位经验者优先。
  • Strong service mindset with excellent communication, listening, and problem-solving skills.
  • 具备高度的服务意识，以及出色的沟通、倾听和解决问题的能力。
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks simultaneously, and thrive in a hybrid working environment.
  • 能够独立工作，处理多项任务，并能适应混合办公模式。
  • Fast learner with the ability to quickly grasp technical product features and effectively communicate them to non-technical users.
  • 学习能力强，能快速掌握技术产品功能，并将其有效传达给非技术型用户。

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: ORTH Enterprise Account Executive — Brazil
description:
Why ORTH

ORTH is an AI agronomist built by Aydi Technologies. It knows a grower's fields, soil, crops and weather, answers agronomic questions in seconds, sends early risk alerts days before problems show in the field, and keeps export compliance (PHI, MRL) in view. More than 300,000 growers use it since its launch in 2025, and enterprise agribusinesses run it across their operations through ORTH Teams and the Enterprise plan.

Role Overview

As an Enterprise AE, you own the territory end to end. You build the enterprise pipeline, represent ORTH at the events and in the fields that matter, run pilots, negotiate and close, and then manage the portfolio through renewal and expansion. You work alongside an ORTH Customer Success lead who owns implementation and customer success at each account; together you decide where the territory goes next.

What You'll Do

  • Pipeline: Build and run the enterprise pipeline across large-scale growers, cooperatives, tradings, fruit and coffee exporters, input distributors and integrated agribusinesses in Brazil.
  • Presence: Represent ORTH at the trade shows, grower days and industry events where decisions get made in your market.
  • Discovery: Lead multi-stakeholder discovery with agronomy directors, operations heads, sustainability leads and owners, with the aim of understanding pressing use cases for an adequate ORTH implementation.
  • Pilots: Design and run pilots with agreed use cases and success criteria.
  • Closing: Own pricing, negotiation, procurement and legal review, with support from HQ.
  • Portfolio: Own roll-out plans, implementation schedules, renewal and expansion across your accounts, and hold the executive relationship.
  • Squad: Partner with your customer success lead on use case definition and implementation health. You own the agreement; they own the field.
  • Voice of the market: Feed what growers ask for to our solution engineers for quick resolution and learning.
  • Operating rigour: Report pipeline, forecast and account health with discipline.
  • What You Have

Ideal candidates can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

  • Years working in or selling into agriculture in Brazil. You have stood in fields with growers and you understand Brazil's agronomic landscape, regions, seasons and crops.
  • Agronomic training, a related degree, or the equivalent built through work.
  • An existing network across the enterprise logos in Brazil: you have sold into them or worked alongside them, and you know who decides.
  • A track record of performance against a sales KPI in complex, multi-stakeholder cycles.
  • Owning a revenue, renewal and expansion target.
  • Running in-person meetings with owners, CFOs and agronomy directors.
  • Mapping an organization and influencing stakeholders from field scout to board.
  • Curiosity about AI and a clear point of view on what it should and should not do in agriculture.
  • Comfort with frequent travel across the territory.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English. Spanish is an advantage for working with the wider ORTH team.
  • Commercial and entrepreneurial acumen: you can build a business case and present it to a board. The interview process includes a case study.
  • People want to work with you. Direct, reliable, easy to trust on the farm and in the boardroom.
